name: session_search
description: Full-text search over transcripts. Defaults to this conversation, which is how you reach back for detail that compaction has folded away — anything said earlier here is still findable even when you can no longer see it. Pass session:"all" to search every conversation, or a session id to search that one.

query.description: Words to look for. Each word matches as a prefix, and punctuation is looked for as written: "follow-up", "notes.md", and "AND" are all fine.

session.description: Where to look. Omit for this conversation; "all" for every conversation; or a session id.
